title: Linh's Saving Plan
segments: After a busy lunch shift at the cafe, Linh counted her tips. She smiled, but then frowned. Her favorite cơm tấm lunch cost too much. She wanted to buy a new study book for her English class. But if she spent all her money on food, she would never save enough.

Because of this, Linh told her friend about her problem with saving money for the study book. Her friend suggested a free budgeting app. "It can help you track your spending," she said. Linh thought it was a great idea! After work, she quickly went home and tried to install the app on her old phone.

However, installing the app was harder than Linh thought. Her old phone was very slow. The screen froze many times. She didn't understand all the installation steps. Linh felt frustrated. She thought about giving up on her saving plan for the study book. It seemed impossible to track her expenses now.

After that, Linh returned to work, still frustrated. A kind customer, Ms. Hoa, noticed Linh’s struggle with her old phone. “Is everything okay?” Ms. Hoa asked gently. Linh explained her problem with the budgeting app. Ms. Hoa offered to help. Together, they successfully cài đặt ứng dụng. Ms. Hoa then showed Linh how to log her cơm tấm purchase.

Because of Ms. Hoa's help, Linh started using the budgeting app every day. She carefully logged her cơm tấm, nước mía, and other small expenses. Over the next few weeks, Linh saw her savings grow from her cafe work. She felt very proud when she made her first small deposit at the 'ngân hàng' (bank) for her new study book.

Because of this, Linh continued using the budgeting app. Each day, she tracked her expenses, especially her favorite cơm tấm and nước mía. Soon, her savings were enough! With a happy heart, Linh visited the bookstore. She finally bought the study book she wanted, thanks to her hard work and Ms. Hoa’s help. Linh felt a great sense of accomplishment.
endWrap: Linh's journey showed that with a good plan and a little help, big goals are possible. She learned the value of tracking expenses and saving diligently for her dreams.
